label: Catch-up run (local, from the reader's own machine)

sources.name: Crossref topic search (8 themes)
sources.status: ok - 8 theme queries, 80 rows, from the reader's machine. The cloud task cannot reach this API at all, because a scheduled run may only fetch a URL that appeared in a web-search result.

sources.name: Journal watch: 20 of 20 journals swept
sources.status: ok - all 20 titles that are switched on were swept by ISSN through Crossref, which also covers the publishers whose own sites block automation (ScienceDirect, Taylor and Francis, SAGE). This is the first complete sweep since 28 September.

sources.name: OpenAlex paper search (2 themes: par, ai)
sources.status: ok - 11 candidates. OpenAlex replaces the semantic-search tool, which is not available on this machine. It needs no key and has no weekly quota, and it gives a DOI, an exact date and an abstract for most works. The next rotation index is 6 (dec, pc).

sources.name: Bluesky
sources.status: ok - 20 candidates from the 2 accounts in the profile. The list 'Reading Radar' does not exist on this account, so the account set cannot grow from a list yet.

sources.name: ScienceGuide
sources.status: partial - the news index is readable and gave 5 links; the individual article pages were not needed for the metadata that an item keeps.

sources.name: RSS feeds
sources.status: none configured - the 7 feeds the reader wants still need a real feed URL. The guesses ScienceGuide, NRO, Vereniging Hogescholen and SIA all return 404, so each site must be checked for a feed link. ITD Alliance does publish one.

sources.name: Abstract enrichment (OpenAlex by DOI)
sources.status: ok - 37 abstracts were filled. 102 of the 209 candidates now hold an abstract. A candidate without one keeps a caveat that says the abstract was not read.

sources.name: ROOTS lineage
sources.status: partial - 1 lineage document completed from the Crossref reference list (53 of 53 references read, 8 strands). 5 further drafts are ready in data/inbox/lineage and wait for the judgement pass. The reference list that the cloud run had to scrape from a publisher page came straight from the API here.

notes: The second consecutive week that the cloud task was degraded, so this run moved the harvest to the reader's own machine. That repairs the two structural blockers: every API is reachable here (Crossref, OpenAlex, Bluesky, RSS), and the reference lists are reachable, so ROOTS works again. What stays broken is the full text of ScienceDirect, Taylor and Francis and SAGE, and the fetch rule of the cloud task itself. The window was widened to 5 October because the 5 and 12 October cloud runs covered little. 209 candidates came in and 28 were kept, which is the cap of PROJECT.md; 181 candidates stay in data/inbox/items as the backlog, and 5 lineage drafts stay in data/inbox/lineage. The judgement pass is the one step that a script cannot do.
